recovery.reason: Production checkpoints are being saved automatically.

warnings: Ligands are retained with their bound heavy-atom coordinates. Preparation assigns a recorded fixed protonation state and GAFF2 / AM1-BCC parameters for explicit-water OpenMM dynamics.
Retained ions use declared monatomic charge states and require explicit TIP3P water; coordination energetics and alternate oxidation states are not modeled.
Missing sequence-supported residues are listed. Rebuilding internal short gaps is opt-in and produces low-confidence coordinates, not an experimentally established loop.
Missing terminal sequence is reported but not rebuilt. The observed structure is prepared as a truncated chain with terminal groups.
pH assignment uses OpenMM template/heuristic protonation and histidine tautomer rules, not a pKa calculation or constant-pH simulation.

resources.note: Planning estimates include retained coordinates and working copies; native engines can use additional memory. Runtime is measured after dynamics starts.

ligands.protonation_method: Dimorphite-DL 2 empirical site rules at requested pH, pKa precision=0; amide/N–N sites retained from source; original graph/stereotags preserved; no microscopic pKa or tautomer ranking
warnings: Ligand protonation is a fixed model choice; it is not a binding-site pKa calculation or a tautomer ranking.
ligands.stereo_limitations: Carbon tetrahedral CCD/input-SMILES configurations are checked. Nitrogen inversion, atropisomerism, and phosphorus stereodescriptors after ionization are not validated; the original bound heavy-atom pose is retained.

ions.model: Amber TIP3P 12-6 nonbonded ion; not a bonded coordination, charge-transfer or oxidation-state model.
